g.text: Distribution of input and output tokens per request — Azure multimodal inference traces, 2025

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: how input and output token counts are distributed across 1,000,000 observed Azure inference requests. Left

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: panel counts requests per token bin; right panel gives the cumulative share, so any percentile reads off the curve.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Microsoft Azure, AzurePublicDataset — multimodal (LMM) inference production traces (2025 release, CC-BY) —

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: §3.2 — What we measured; §7.9 — De-duplication rule 3, sub-types

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Observation window — multimodal 15 Oct 2024 – 22 Oct 2024. Input tokens include image tokens as well as text, so this is not

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: comparable with the text-only traces and the two must never be pooled. Despite the 2025 release label the observation window is

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: October 2024, and Microsoft describes the file as a sample of the cluster's traffic rather than its full volume. The horizontal axis

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: is log-scaled because token counts span several orders of magnitude and a linear axis would collapse everything below a thousand

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: tokens into a single bar; bins are left-closed powers of two. No request is excluded and the full long tail is drawn.
